articles.description: The same tech start-up that discovered a PHP flaw used AI to uncover a critical software bug in one of the world's most popular computer language programs.
articles.summary: A tech start-up used AI to uncover a critical software bug in Java that had existed for more than a decade A cyber-security firm has used artificial intelligence (AI) to uncover a critical flaw in the hugely popular computer programming language Java.
key_points: Tech start-up Calif - which recently identified a cyber-security flaw in another language, PHP - found the bug in Java's memory functions.
Java is the world's third largest programming language used by 90% of the world's Fortune 500 companies like Apple and Amazon, and many banks, hospitals and governments.
The discovery comes after a string of serious technology issues, including a massive Microsoft outage and a network failure that grounded all US flights.
